name: komdosh-claude-developer
description: Backend + infrastructure engineering suite for Claude Code — 8 composable plugins. The Kotlin + Spring wave is four plugins: core (implementation, events, Avro), quality (security/PII audits, vendor-leak audit, QA artifacts), delivery (lifecycle gates, Jira entry, architecture-driven planning, two-track release engineering), and revealer (project knowledge + source documentation), plus kotlin-extras for niche maintenance tooling. The infrastructure wave is three: infra-core (safety, secrets, GitOps, and data-protection discipline plus cross-cutting review), infra-iac (Terraform/OpenTofu with the Yandex Cloud layer built in), and infra-k8s (Kubernetes hardening with ArgoCD delivery). Every auditor is read-only; nothing applies, deploys, or syncs on its own.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-spring-core
plugins.description: The must-have foundation for Kotlin + Spring WebFlux/coroutines services: implementation, events, and Avro schemas in one plugin. 8 agents (backend-implementer, test-writer, cleanuper, integration-debugger, service-bootstrapper, event-consumer-author, avro-schema-author, and the read-only code-reviewer that reviews a diff at scope=diff or audits the whole service at scope=service) · 13 commands · 11 skills (coroutine-safety-scan, module-boundary-check, pii-safety-scan, liquibase-changeset-immutability, jooq-generation-freshness, pre-edit-impact-check, check-adr-required, read-service-context, run-verification, discover-avro-toolchain, verify-schema-compat) · 19 rule documents · 2 hooks. Enforces hexagonal boundaries, the 12 forbidden coroutine patterns, RFC 9457 errors, application-layer PII handling, event-consumer idempotency and DLQ policy, and Avro schema/registry discipline.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-spring-quality
plugins.description: The audit and QA-artifact suite on top of komdosh-dev-spring-core. 5 agents — security-auditor (route↔SecurityWebFilterChain coverage, RFC 9457 error leakage, JWT/JWK rotation, PII on the data-in-motion surface), platform-developer (vendor-coupling leaks in application/ and domain/, staged into a common/ module), and three QA writers (qa-plan-writer, qa-postman-writer, qa-console-writer) · 7 commands — /qa [plan|postman|console|all] from one shared API-surface discovery, /security-audit plus its four narrowed entry points (/auth-audit, /error-leakage-check, /jwt-rotation, /pii-leakage-check), and /audit-leaks · 4 skills · 2 rules. Read-only on the audit side: never modifies code, never extracts secrets, never prints personal data. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-spring-delivery
plugins.description: Everything between 'a ticket exists' and 'the release PR is open'. Lifecycle orchestration (/lifecycle status|next|orchestrate|audit computes a gate map from real git state and recommends the next action; /recommend routes a task to the right marketplace capability), Jira-driven task entry (/jira-task pulls a ticket via the Atlassian MCP and walks its workflow forward), architecture-driven planning (/implementation-plan turns a service's architecture package into ordered agent todos), and two-track release engineering — service (/release-prep, /changelog, /version-bump, /release-notes, /rollback-playbook) and library (adds /abi-check, /publish-prep, /deprecate-api, with ABI-load-bearing version bumps). 4 agents · 12 commands · 11 skills · 2 rules. Never deploys, never pushes tags, never merges a PR. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-revealer
plugins.description: Retrieval before invention — two ladders, one discipline: answer from a real source, cite it, and name the gaps instead of filling them. /reveal <query> surfaces accumulated project knowledge (ADRs, specs, plans, code-embedded DECISION/RATIONALE comments, commit archaeology, and any RAG/MCP knowledge base wired up — codebase-memory, Confluence/Notion/Linear, context7, ref-context) in survey / decision-trace / gap-find modes. /doc-reveal <symbol|topic|library> resolves source documentation cheapest-first (in-repo KDoc/Javadoc → project docs → local cache → MCP → canonical web docs → pre-indexed JAR listings → decompilation as a last resort), caching results so repeats are instant. 2 agents · 2 commands · 2 skills · 1 rule. Read-only on project source; degrades gracefully when no MCP is configured.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-kotlin-extras
plugins.description: Niche tooling on top of komdosh-dev-spring-core — install only if you need any of these. Ships /upgrade (dependency-upgrader: bumps one library at a time in libs.versions.toml with changelog awareness, capped at 5 compile-fix iterations); /detect-flakes (flaky-test-detector: re-runs tests N times, classifies, appends to docs/flakes.md, routes to specialist); /load-test-new (load-test-scaffolder: scaffolds Gatling simulations). Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-infra-core
plugins.description: Must-have foundation for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps work — the shared safety, secrets-hygiene, promotion, and data-protection discipline every infra plugin builds on. Ships three read-only agents (infra-reviewer — correctness · security · blast radius · drift · cost · reversibility; secrets-sentinel — leak audit across every layer; data-protection-auditor — PII across the data lifecycle with 152-FZ + GDPR), three internal skills (discover-infra-context repo-mapper, infra-safety-scan and pii-exposure-scan grep preflights), six rule documents (iac-safety, secrets-hygiene, gitops-principles, environment-promotion, infra-review, pii-data-protection), a millisecond-scale SessionStart context hook, and a recommended read-only permission set. Standalone — no cloud or language assumptions; the terraform, kubernetes, argocd, and yandex plugins depend on it.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-infra-iac
plugins.description: Terraform and OpenTofu authoring, plan-safety analysis, and state discipline — with the Yandex Cloud resource layer built in. Ships iac-author (module structure, pinned providers, for_each over count by stable key, remote encrypted state, prevent_destroy on stateful resources; on YC: VPC with per-zone subnets and default-deny security groups, Managed K8s with regional HA masters, Managed PostgreSQL/Kafka/Redis with HA + backups, Lockbox + KMS, Container Registry, least-privilege IAM) and the read-only iac-reviewer (correctness · state safety · security · cost · drift; on YC: IAM over-grants, SA-key exposure, network exposure, managed-DB HA, zonal masters in prod, Audit Trails, and PII residency under 152-FZ and GDPR). Four skills: discover-terraform-layout, verify-plan-safety (classifies every create/update/replace/destroy and flags forces-replacement before apply), discover-yc-context, verify-yc-resources. Seven rules: terraform-style, terraform-state-safety, terraform-plan-review, yc-terraform, yc-security, yc-managed-services, yc-data-residency. Six commands: /tf-module, /tf-plan-review, /tf-audit, /yc-provision, /yc-audit, /yc-context. Uses the Terraform registry MCP for current versions. Never runs apply or destroy. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.

plugins.name: komdosh-dev-infra-k8s
plugins.description: Kubernetes manifest authoring, security hardening, workload troubleshooting, and ArgoCD GitOps delivery. Ships three agents — k8s-author (hardened Deployments/StatefulSets, Kustomize overlays, Helm values, all three probes, PDB, topology spread, graceful shutdown; plus ArgoCD Application/ApplicationSet/AppProject with pinned prod revisions, scoped projects, prune+selfHeal, sync waves), the read-only k8s-auditor (Pod Security Standards restricted + resource discipline + reliability on the rendered manifests, plus GitOps hygiene — moving prod revisions, default projects, inline secrets, drift-hiding ignoreDifferences), and the read-only k8s-diagnostician (root-cause diagnosis of CrashLoopBackOff / ImagePullBackOff / OOMKilled / Pending / probe failures, and of OutOfSync / Degraded / stuck-Progressing / drifting apps — separating sync status from health status). Four skills: discover-k8s-workloads, probe-cluster-state, discover-argocd-apps, probe-app-health. Five rules: k8s-manifests, k8s-security, k8s-resources, argocd-applications, gitops-delivery. Six commands: /k8s-manifest, /k8s-audit, /k8s-debug, /argo-app, /argo-audit, /argo-diagnose. Never mutates a cluster and never syncs out of band — rollback is git revert. Requires komdosh-dev-infra-core.
